THIRD-PARTY COMPONENTS USED BY BioModelling Pro
===============================================

BioModelling Pro (GPL-3.0-or-later) includes unmodified copies of the following open-source
libraries in this folder, and loads others from a public content-delivery network when the
statistics, machine-learning and modelling steps are first used. Each keeps its own licence,
reproduced below or referenced as that licence requires.

INCLUDED IN vendor/
-------------------
1. leaflet/leaflet.js, leaflet/leaflet.css, leaflet/images/*   (Leaflet 1.9.4, web maps)
   Licence: BSD 2-Clause. (C) 2010-2026 Volodymyr Agafonkin; (C) 2010-2011 CloudMade. Full text: vendor/leaflet/LICENSE.txt
   Source: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet

2. geotiff.js   (geotiff.js 2.1.3, reads GeoTIFF rasters in the browser)
   Licence: MIT. (C) 2015 EOX IT Services GmbH. Source: https://github.com/geotiffjs/geotiff.js

3. html2canvas.min.js   (html2canvas 1.4.1, exports the map view to a PNG image)
   Licence: MIT. (C) 2012 Niklas von Hertzen. Source: https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas

LOADED FROM A CONTENT-DELIVERY NETWORK (not redistributed here)
---------------------------------------------------------------
4. Pyodide 0.27.2 (Python in WebAssembly)   Licence: MPL-2.0.   https://pyodide.org
   With the scientific packages built for it: NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn (BSD-3-Clause)
   and Matplotlib (Matplotlib licence, a PSF-style permissive licence).

DATA
----
See NOTICE.md at the root of the project: it states, source by source, what is redistributed here and what is
not. In short:
- Map tiles are requested from public tile servers and carry their own attribution, shown on the map.
- WorldClim 2.1 (Fick & Hijmans, 2017, Int. J. Climatol.) is free for academic and other non-commercial use,
  but REDISTRIBUTION OR COMMERCIAL USE IS NOT ALLOWED WITHOUT PRIOR PERMISSION (worldclim.org/about.html).
  The global layers are therefore not distributed here; datos/LEE-ME.md says how to download them. The only
  WorldClim material that travels with the program is the cropped subset of the bundled example
  (js/example-rasters.js), which is there for teaching, is separable, and is not covered by the GPL.
- The Koeppen-Geiger maps of Beck et al. (2018, Scientific Data) are CC BY 4.0 and are redistributed with
  attribution, both in datos/koppen/ and in the bundled example.
- Species records are requested from the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) and remain under the
  licences declared by their publishers. The publishers of the bundled example are listed in
  datos/GBIF-FUENTES.md.
- js/mexico-states.js holds the boundaries of the 32 federal entities of Mexico used by the region filter of
  step 2. They come from Natural Earth (admin 1 states and provinces, 1:10 million scale, naturalearthdata.com),
  which is in the public domain and requires no permission, filtered to Mexico and simplified with the
  Douglas-Peucker algorithm to a tolerance of about 0.4 km.
